body:
S20-01: PRRJECT_FATBABY/docs/mysql-read-model-schema.md written.
Tables: governance_signals (ticker/event_type/date/signal_score), eps_results
(ticker/period/eps_actual/estimate/surprise_pct), entity_timeline (ordered entity
state changes), projector_cursors (eventstore cursor tracking per projector).
Projector pattern documented. signalapi query endpoint shapes documented.
Migration file pattern: migrations/mysql/ (mirrors IDUNA truestore pattern).

S20-03: PRRJECT_FATBABY/docs/mongo-entity-schema.md written.
One MongoDB document per company (ticker as key). Denormalized: directors,
auditor, governance_events, eps_history, activist_positions, watchlist.
Indexes, writer pattern (ReplaceOne/upsert), signalapi entity endpoint spec.
Local dev: docker mongo:7 on :27017.

Both specs reviewed. S20-02 (MySQL projector impl) and S20-04 (MongoDB writer) next.
title: S20-01/03: MySQL + MongoDB schema specs written for FatBaby queryability
